name: @drawpaper/desktop-tauri
description: drawpaper Windows desktop shell (Tauri 2 + WebView2). Frontend is packages/web; this package only owns the Rust shell and build glue.
//: This package is intentionally NOT part of the root pnpm workspace.
Root pnpm-workspace.yaml only globs packages/*, so apps/ is invisible to pnpm -r.
Install deps here in isolation if needed: pnpm i --ignore-workspace (or npm i).
The web frontend is built by the root workspace; beforeDevCommand/beforeBuildCommand below call into ../../packages/web.
frontendDist points at ../../packages/web/dist — run `pnpm -r build` at repo root before `tauri build`.
